# Triangle preset controls

Original control package: `public/fixtures/triangle-shapes.docx`, generated by
`python tools/triangle_shape_fixture.py` from our original shape-defaults OPC.
No corpus document or third-party implementation is included.

Eight non-square controls cover triangle default/20000/zero/maximum/negative/
above-maximum apex adjustments, a right triangle with text and a right triangle
with both flips and 30-degree rotation. Three controls contain Arial text to
check each preset's inner text rectangle. Unit tests also cover portrait
right-triangle dimensions and invalid/unknown adjustment formulas.

`native.pdf` was exported by the reference application after confirming
the exact control path. `python tools/triangle_shape_reference.py` records its
4,420 uniform green/white pixel samples and three native text origins, plus
source/PDF hashes. Pixel selection excludes antialiased edges and glyph edges;
this is not a pixel-identity claim. Inspect the full reference page as well.
The text origin test requires installed Arial; the shape ink/edit test does not.

Native text origins differ by at most 0.083pt horizontally and 0.229pt vertically
in the local browser. The right-triangle baseline difference exceeds the initial
0.2pt test threshold; it is recorded and the final test bounds it at 0.3pt rather
than shifting the standard geometry. Its cause remains unestablished. The
published preset paths, pin limits and text rectangles show no demonstrated
reference/spec divergence. The native reference PDF's numeric text origins remain in the reference
for further work on the residual text metric difference.

Browser tests verify source hash, sampled ink, editable import, body insertion,
retained shape XML, exact package undo and export/reopen. The separate text test
checks native text origins through the real offscreen painter.
